name: real-app
_comment: FrameConsole (run with --host <sender IP>, 127.0.0.1 when the generator runs on the sender PC). One broadcast, source quality only; every viewer also holds the chat socket and 5% send 6 messages/min. Hold 45 s per stage for fast iteration (not a capacity soak; use soak.json for that). Target statistics come only from the app's read-only GET /api/stats (contract v 1): session count, send rate, the source ingest rate as the full-rate reference, and the stop rules (degraded-below-min, success-below-min, whep-503-share, generator-cpu / host-cpu / host-memory). The stages past this PC's loopback limit (~50-75 viewers of 8 Mbit/s) stay in the file on purpose: the stop rules end the run there. Traffic cap 40 GB covers all planned stages (~16 GB at 8.6 Mbit/s, ~23 GB at 12 Mbit/s), so it never cuts a planned stage. Browser pages (1 desktop + 1 mobile-like, 20 s) run only in a separate phase after the holds of stages 1 and 10, never inside a hold.
